DECISION: Remove search bar and Frequently Used section from emoji keyboard
OPTIONS: Keep search bar + frequently used (native match) vs remove both for simplicity
REASONING: We don't track emoji usage so Frequently Used would always be empty. Search bar clutters the limited extension height. User explicitly chose simplicity over native parity for emoji.
CURRENT STATE:
  - First section: SMILEYS & PEOPLE (no Frequently Used header)
  - 7-column emoji grid
  - Section headers for each category
  - Bottom category tab bar: clock | 😊 | 🐻 | 🍔 | ⚽ | ✈️ | 💡 | ♥️ | 🏳️ | ⌫
  - ABC button at far left (5%,90% coordinate)
  - No UISearchBar, no search delegate, no filtered categories
REVISIT WHEN: If we implement emoji usage tracking
